package web

import (
	"errors"
	"math"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/db/sqlc"
	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/identity"
	"github.com/gogogadget/gogogadget/internal/web/templates"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

// exampleNoticePageSize is the rows-per-page of the read surfaces.
const exampleNoticePageSize = 20

// exampleNoticeFormInput is the HTML form body.
// The JSON transport has its own request type; both run the same validator, so
// the two transports cannot disagree about what a valid name is.
type exampleNoticeFormInput struct {
	Name string `form:"name"`
}

// validateExampleNoticeName is the name rule every transport runs: required,
// 80 characters or fewer after trimming. It returns the cleaned value and a
// message, empty when valid.
func validateExampleNoticeName(name string) (string, string) {
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	switch {
	case name == "":
		return name, "Name is required."
	case len(name) > 80:
		return name, "Name must be 80 characters or fewer."
	default:
		return name, ""
	}
}

// GET /app/example-notices
//
// The app read surface. Read only: the mutations live on the other surface,
// so this one renders the table without write controls.
func (s *Server) handleExampleNotices(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	query := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("q"))
	pageNumber, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("page"))
	if pageNumber < 1 {
		pageNumber = 1
	}
	total, err := s.q.CountExampleNotices(ctx, query)
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	rows, err := s.q.ListExampleNotices(ctx, sqlc.ListExampleNoticesParams{Query: query, Lim: exampleNoticePageSize, Off: int32((pageNumber - 1) * exampleNoticePageSize)})
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	// An explicit view row rather than the query row: the template package then
	// depends on nothing generated, and adding a column cannot silently change
	// what the table renders.
	items := make([]templates.ExampleNoticeItem, 0, len(rows))
	for _, row := range rows {
		items = append(items, templates.ExampleNoticeItem{ID: row.ID, Name: row.Name, CreatedAt: row.CreatedAt.Time})
	}
	data := templates.ExampleNoticesListData{
		Items: items, Query: query, Page: pageNumber,
		TotalPages: max(int(math.Ceil(float64(total)/exampleNoticePageSize)), 1),
		BaseURL:    "/app/example-notices",
		Writable:   false,
		Admin:      false,
	}
	pageData := Page{Title: "Example notices", Layout: templates.LayoutApp}
	if wantsFragment(r) {
		s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleNoticesTable(data))
		return
	}
	s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleNoticesPage(data))
}

// GET /admin/example-notices
//
// The staff read surface. Search, pagination, and the create/edit form on
// one page: ?edit=<id> loads a row into that form, so editing needs neither
// a second route nor a second template.
func (s *Server) handleAdminExampleNotices(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	query := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("q"))
	pageNumber, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("page"))
	if pageNumber < 1 {
		pageNumber = 1
	}
	total, err := s.q.CountExampleNotices(ctx, query)
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	rows, err := s.q.ListExampleNotices(ctx, sqlc.ListExampleNoticesParams{Query: query, Lim: exampleNoticePageSize, Off: int32((pageNumber - 1) * exampleNoticePageSize)})
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	// An explicit view row rather than the query row: the template package then
	// depends on nothing generated, and adding a column cannot silently change
	// what the table renders.
	items := make([]templates.ExampleNoticeItem, 0, len(rows))
	for _, row := range rows {
		items = append(items, templates.ExampleNoticeItem{ID: row.ID, Name: row.Name, CreatedAt: row.CreatedAt.Time})
	}
	data := templates.ExampleNoticesListData{
		Items: items, Query: query, Page: pageNumber,
		TotalPages: max(int(math.Ceil(float64(total)/exampleNoticePageSize)), 1),
		BaseURL:    "/admin/example-notices",
		Writable:   true,
		Admin:      true,
	}
	data.Form.WriteURL = "/admin/example-notices"
	if raw := r.URL.Query().Get("edit"); raw != "" {
		id, parseErr := strconv.ParseInt(raw, 10, 64)
		if parseErr != nil {
			s.handleNotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		// A row outside the caller's tenant is a 404, never a 403: a 403 would
		// confirm that the id exists.
		row, getErr := s.q.GetExampleNoticeByID(ctx, id)
		if errors.Is(getErr, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
			s.handleNotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		if getErr != nil {
			s.renderError(w, r, getErr.Error())
			return
		}
		data.Form.ID, data.Form.Name = row.ID, row.Name
	}
	pageData := Page{Title: "Example notices", Layout: templates.LayoutAdmin}
	if wantsFragment(r) {
		s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleNoticesTable(data))
		return
	}
	s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.AdminExampleNoticesPage(data))
}

// renderExampleNoticeFormError re-renders the form with 422:
// the fragment for htmx, which swaps it into #example-notice-form, and the standalone
// form page otherwise. The write URL is set here rather than by four callers
// that could each forget it.
func (s *Server) renderExampleNoticeFormError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, form templates.ExampleNoticeFormData) {
	form.WriteURL = "/admin/example-notices"
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
	pageData := Page{Title: "Example notices", Layout: templates.LayoutAdmin}
	if wantsFragment(r) {
		s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleNoticeForm(form))
		return
	}
	s.Render(w, r, pageData, templates.ExampleNoticeFormPage(form))
}

// POST /admin/example-notices
func (s *Server) handleExampleNoticeCreate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	user := identity.UserFrom(ctx)
	var input exampleNoticeFormInput
	if err := decodeForm(r, &input); err != nil {
		s.renderExampleNoticeFormError(w, r, templates.ExampleNoticeFormData{})
		return
	}
	name, nameErr := validateExampleNoticeName(input.Name)
	if nameErr != "" {
		s.renderExampleNoticeFormError(w, r, templates.ExampleNoticeFormData{Name: name, NameErr: nameErr})
		return
	}
	row, err := s.q.CreateExampleNotice(ctx, name)
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	s.logAudit(ctx, "", user.UserID, "example_notice.created", map[string]any{"id": row.ID, "name": row.Name})
	Toast(w, "success", "Example notice created")
	Navigate(w, r, "/admin/example-notices")
}

// POST /admin/example-notices/{id}
func (s *Server) handleExampleNoticeUpdate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	user := identity.UserFrom(ctx)
	id, err := strconv.ParseInt(r.PathValue("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		s.handleNotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	var input exampleNoticeFormInput
	if decodeErr := decodeForm(r, &input); decodeErr != nil {
		s.renderExampleNoticeFormError(w, r, templates.ExampleNoticeFormData{ID: id})
		return
	}
	name, nameErr := validateExampleNoticeName(input.Name)
	if nameErr != "" {
		s.renderExampleNoticeFormError(w, r, templates.ExampleNoticeFormData{ID: id, Name: name, NameErr: nameErr})
		return
	}
	// The tenant predicate is in the UPDATE, so a cross-tenant id matches no
	// row and arrives here as ErrNoRows: one round trip, no existence leak.
	row, err := s.q.UpdateExampleNotice(ctx, sqlc.UpdateExampleNoticeParams{ID: id, Name: name})
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		s.handleNotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	s.logAudit(ctx, "", user.UserID, "example_notice.updated", map[string]any{"id": row.ID, "name": row.Name})
	Toast(w, "success", "Example notice updated")
	Navigate(w, r, "/admin/example-notices")
}

// DELETE /admin/example-notices/{id}
//
// Row swap: 200 with an empty body, and htmx removes the tr.
func (s *Server) handleExampleNoticeDelete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	ctx := r.Context()
	user := identity.UserFrom(ctx)
	id, err := strconv.ParseInt(r.PathValue("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		s.handleNotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	affected, err := s.q.DeleteExampleNotice(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		s.renderError(w, r, err.Error())
		return
	}
	if affected == 0 {
		s.handleNotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	s.logAudit(ctx, "", user.UserID, "example_notice.deleted", map[string]any{"id": id})
	Toast(w, "success", "Example notice deleted")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
